segments.text: Before we begin today's treatment, let's prepare our equipment and environment.
First, you'll need a candle, fixed on a small plate to catch the melting wax, and a lighter or a box of matches.
Next, find a quiet place to do this treatment, and make sure there are no obvious hazards near you or on you.
For example, a curtain blowing next to you.
Or maybe you want to secure any loose strands of long hair or remove a scarf or bulky jacket that you're wearing.
Finally, make sure you're sitting comfortably on a chair or on the ground.
Keep the candle and lighter next to you and place your hands open on your lap, palms facing upwards.
When you're ready, let your eyes close and the sounds from around you melt away.

As you draw your attention inwards, at this point, take note of how you're feeling, the state of your thoughts, your emotions, your desire to connect with the healing and calming power of Mother Kundalini within you.
Now, raise your hands to the level of your chest and hold them out parallel to your lap, with your attention on your Sahasrara, at the top of your head.
Ask the energy within you, Mother, please show me the condition of my vibrations, or Mother, please show me the condition of my subtle system.
Notice the vibrations on your hands, any heaviness, warmth, coolness, paying special attention to your left hand.
Rest your hands on your lap again and close your eyes. Once you feel settled, let your eyes open.
And light your candle placing it next to your left knee.
If you are on a chair you might need a stool or small table on your left to place the candle upon.
We are going to use the candle to work on each chakra of the left side of our body.
We will start at the first chakra and work our way up towards the top of our head.
As you know, on our hands, the Mooladhara chakra is located at the base of our palm.
Place this part of your hand on your left hand towards the flame and keep your right hand open on your lap.
With your attention on your left Mooladhara chakra, we can say,
Mother, please let all the negativity from my left Mooladhara be absorbed by the fire.
Please purify this chakra and make it strong.
Now we move upwards to the left Swadhisthana chakra located at your lower abdomen where your left hip meets the torso.
For the rest of the treatment, we will keep our left hand open on our lap using the right hand to hold the candle up to each chakra.
At the left Swadhisthana,
Let's give a few small bandhans with the candle by tracing a small horseshoe shape back and forth in front of the chakra.
If you prefer, you can also just hold the candle steady in front of the chakra,
though the bandhans help to remove the negativity more effectively.
As we do this, we can affirm, Mother Kundalini,
Please let all the false knowledge and negativity be absorbed by the fire.
Please purify this chakra and make it strong.
Now, moving on to our Nabhi chakra, located in the upper abdomen area,
just below the ribcage on the left hand side.
Again, give this chakra a few bandhans with the candle while saying, Mother,
Please remove all selfishness, discontentment, and negativity from this chakra into the fire.
Please purify and strengthen my left Nabhi.
We can raise the candle to our heart chakra and give a few bandhanas here.
We can say, Mother, please let my attachments, closed-heartedness and fear be removed by the fire element.
Let my heart become strong, clean, and nourished.
Our next chakra is located on the left side of our neck.
So, turning our head to the right, we can carefully do a few bandhans here.
Mother, let all the guilt, impure attention, and negativity from my left Vishuddhi be absorbed by the fire.
Please make this chakra strong and pure.
Next,
We'll move on to the left Agnya, which is located on the right side of our head.
Carefully do a few small bandhan here, or simply hold the candle at a safe distance next to your head.
Keeping our attention on this chakra, we can say in our hearts,
Mother, please let all my conditionings, self-doubt and negative thinking
Be removed from my left Agnya into the fire. Let this chakra become pure and strong.
To conclude the treatment, we will do a sweep of our whole left side with the candle.
Keeping your left hand on your lap, take the candle to your left hip
and slowly raise it up your body past your Nabhi, heart, Vishuddhi, crossing over to the Agnya
And back down the same way to your left hip.
Mother, please purify my entire left channel and fill it with joy, balance, and contentment.
Now you may blow out your candle and place it beside you.
Open both your hands on your lap and let your eyes close.
Bring your attention to your Sahasrara at the top of your head.
If it helps.
You can gently press the top of your head with your right hand and return it to your lap. Keep your attention there.
Let's sit for a minute and let your attention settle at the top of your head and take you into meditation.
Finally, raise both hands parallel to your lap to the level of your chest again and let's see the difference this treatment has made to your vibrations.
Here we can ask, Mother, please show me the condition of my subtle system.
Now, notice the sensations on your hand, the change in coolness or heaviness, especially on your left hand.
You can also take note of how you're feeling inside.
You can place your hands back on your lap.
And this concludes today's candle treatment.
Thank you for joining.
And we hope you will continue to apply this practice to make your left channel strong and resilient.
